# apple_remove_build_testers (Action)

Removes individual beta testers' access to a build. Access through groups is unaffected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_remove_build_testers" "ann" {
  config {
    build_id        = data.apple_build.latest.id
    beta_tester_ids = [apple_beta_tester.ann.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_tester_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the beta testers.
- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
